title: The engine install dialog says "Starting ComfyUI Engine" during minutes of pip work
description: On a fresh install the overlay shows 'Starting ComfyUI Engine... This may take a few moments' while ensureCuratedPythonDeps (routes/comfy.js:472) runs a multi-minute pip pass over dev_configs/python_deps.txt. Reported live by the user 2026-08-10: 'it's a bit of a pain in the ass and kind of reads like it's dead.' The WORK is correct and the timing is deliberate - the curated set is installed at engine START, not at install, because that is the only point that survives an engine upgrade wiping site-packages (MPI-457 measured the alternative: a marker stored one level up survived a wipe, the next start hash-matched and skipped, and ComfyUI came up with No module named 'cv2', 17 shipped class_types gone, no error shown). So do NOT move the work. Fix the REPORTING: the phase label should name the dependency install the way the download phase already names itself, so a long silent wait reads as progress instead of a hang. Only the first start pays it; later starts hash-match and skip in milliseconds.
